## Description and Rationale

I am an independent researcher/student passionate about open data science and applied analytics. I registered for the PRC Data Challenge to gain hands-on experience with real world aviation telemetry and flight planning data from EUROCONTROL and OpenSky Network. My goal is to build robust, reproducible models under open science principles, benchmark my approach on the public leaderboard, and contribute to the broader open aviation research community
